answer: Creating a sybil requires forging that chain, which means redoing verifiable work each round; the marginal cost of an extra identity exceeds the ember reward it can earn, so fake accounts burn more than they gain. Each epoch, participants must prove sustained participation by carrying a unique relic token seeded from prior epoch work, then wander through randomized peer verification rounds where a quorum signs its continuity. From qwe0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
